verses.sanskrit:
कृप उवाच।
              शुश्रूषुरपि दुर्मेधाः पुरुषोऽनियतेन्द्रियः। नालं वेदयितुं कृत्स्नौ धर्मार्थाविति मे मतिः॥१॥
verses.english: Kripa Said "A person who is not intelligent and who has not controlled, his passions, cannot, even if he waits dutifully upon his superiors, understand morality. This is my opinion.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव तावन्मेधावी विनयं यो न शिक्षते। न च किञ्चन जानाति सोऽपि धर्मार्थनिश्वयम्॥२॥
चिरं ह्यपि जडः शूरः पण्डितं पर्युपास्य हि। न स धर्मान्विजानाति दर्वी सुपरसानिव॥३॥
verses.english: By waiting all his life upon a learned person, a brave man, void of understanding, cannot know his duties like a wooden ladle unable to taste the soup.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तमपि तं प्राज्ञः पण्डितं पर्युपास्य हि। क्षिप्रं धर्मान्विजानाति जिह्वा सूपरसानिव॥४॥
verses.english: By waiting upon a learned person for even a moment, the wiseman, however, succeeds in understanding his duties like the tongue tasting the soup.

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रूषुस्त्वेव मेधावी पुरुषो नियतेन्द्रियः। जानीयादागमान्सर्वान् ग्राह्यं च न विरोधयेत्॥५॥
verses.english: An intelligent person who waits upon his superiors and who has controlled his passions succeeds in understanding all the rules of morality and never disputes what is accepted by all.

verses.sanskrit: अनेयस्त्वमानी यो दुरात्मा पापपूरुषः। दिष्टमुत्सृज्य कल्याणं करोति बहुपापकम्॥६॥
verses.english: A sinful person of ungovernable, irreverent, wicked soul, commits sin in seeking his welfare by neglecting destiny.

verses.sanskrit: नाथवन्तं तु सुहृदः प्रतिषेधन्ति पातकात्। निवर्तते तु लक्ष्मीवान्नालक्ष्मीवान्निवर्तते॥७॥
verses.english: Well-wishers try to restrain a friend from committing sin. He who allows himself to be dissuaded succeeds in gaining prosperity. He, that does otherwise suffers misery,

verses.sanskrit: यथा ह्युच्चावचैर्वाक्यैः क्षिप्तचित्तो नियम्यते। तथैव सुहृदा शक्यो नशक्यस्त्ववसीदति॥८॥
तथैव सुहृदं प्राज्ञं कुर्वाणं कर्म पापकम्। प्राज्ञाः सम्प्रतिषेधन्ति यथाशक्ति पुनः पुनः॥९॥
verses.english: When a wise friend is about to commit a wicked act, wise well-wishers repeatedly, and according to the best of their power, try to restrain him. Making up your mind to do what is really beneficial, and restraining yourself by your own self, do by command, O son, so that you may not have to repent afterwards.

verses.sanskrit: स कल्याणे मनः कृत्वा नियम्यात्मानमात्मना। कुरु मे वचनं तात येन पश्चान्न तप्यसे॥१०॥
न वधः पूज्यते लोके सुप्तानामिह धर्मतः। तथैवापास्तशस्त्राणां विमुक्तरथवाजिनाम्॥११॥
verses.english: In this world the destruction of sleeping persons is not praised and sanctioned by religion. The same is the case with persons that have thrown off their arms and come down from cars and horses.

verses.sanskrit: ये च ब्रूयुस्तवास्मीति ये च स्युः शरणागताः। विमुक्तमूर्धजा ये च ये चापि हतवाहनाः॥१२॥
verses.english: They should not also be killed who say-we are yours-and also they who surrender themselves, and they whose locks are dishevelled, and they whose animals have been killed under them or whose cars have been broken.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य स्वप्स्यन्ति पञ्चाला विमुक्तकवचा विभो। विश्वस्ता रजनीं सर्वे प्रेता इव विचेतसः॥१३॥
verses.english: All the Panchalas taking of their armours will sleep to-night, O lord. When asleep, they will be taken dead man.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तेषां तदवस्थानां द्रुह्येत पुरुषोऽनृजुः। व्यक्तं स नरके मज्जेदगाधे विपुलेऽप्लवे॥१४॥
सर्वास्त्रविदुषां लोके श्रेष्ठस्त्वमसि विश्रुतः। न च ते जातु लोकेऽस्मिन् सुसूक्ष्ममपि किल्विषम्॥१५॥
verses.english: In this world you are celebrated as the foremost of all persons knowing the use of weapons, you have not as yet committed even a minute sin.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं पुनः सूर्यसङ्काशः श्वोभूत उदिते रवौ। प्रकाशे सर्वभूतानां विजेता युधि शात्रवान्॥१६॥
असम्भावित रूपं हि त्वयि कर्म विगर्हितम्। शुक्ले रक्तमिवन्यस्तं भवेदिति मतिर्मम॥१७॥
verses.english: This culpable deed, so impossible in one like you, will appear like a red spot on a white sheet. This my opinion.”

verses.sanskrit:
अश्वत्थामोवाच।
              एवमेव यथाऽऽत्थ त्वं मातुलेह न संशयः। तैस्तु पूर्वमयं सेतुः शतधा विदलीकृतः॥१८॥
verses.english: Ashvatthaman said “Forsooth what you say, O maternal uncle, is true. The Pandavas, however, have, before this, deviated from the path of righteousness.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षं भूमिपालानां भवतां चापि सन्निधौ। न्यस्तशस्त्रो मम पिता धृष्टद्युम्नेन पातितः॥१९॥
कर्णश्च पतिते चक्रे रथस्य रथिनां वरः। उत्तमे व्यसने मग्नो हतो गाण्डीवधन्वना॥२०॥
तथा शान्तनवो भीष्मो न्यस्तशस्त्रो निरायुधः। शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य हतो गाण्डीवधन्वना॥२१॥
verses.english: Similarly Shantanu's son Bhishma, after he had laid aside his weapons was killed by Arjuna with Shikhandin placed in his rear.

verses.sanskrit: भूरिश्रवा महेष्वासस्तथा प्रायगतो रणे। कोशतां भूमिपालानां युयुधानेन पातितः॥२२॥
verses.english: So also, the great bowman Bhurishravas, while observing the Praya vow on the field of battle, was killed by Yuyudhana, disregarding the voice of all the kings.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनश्च भीमेन समेत्य गदया रणे। पश्यतां भूमिपालानामधर्मेण निपातितः॥२३॥
verses.english: Having met Bhima is battle with the mace, Duryodhana too has been killed unfairly by the former in the very presence of all the king.

verses.sanskrit: एकाकी बहुभिस्तत्र परिवार्य महारथैः। अधर्मेण नरव्याघ्रो भीमसेनेन पातितः॥२४॥
verses.english: The king was all alone in the midst of a great number of powerful car-warriors cumstances was that king killed by Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: विलापो भग्नसक्थस्य यो मे राज्ञः परिश्रुतः। वार्तिकाणां कथयतां स मे मर्माणि कृन्तति॥२५॥
verses.english: The lamentations of the king, lying prostrate on the Earth with his thighs broken, that I have heard from the messengers circulating the news, are cutting me to the quick.

verses.sanskrit: एवं चाधार्मिकाः पापाः पञ्चाला भिन्नसेतवः। तानेवं भिन्नमर्यादान् किं भवान्न विगर्हति॥२६॥
verses.english: The unrighteous and sinful Panchalas, who have trumpeted virtue, are even such. Why do you not blame them who have transgressed the law of virtue.

verses.sanskrit: पितृहन्तॄनहं हत्वा पाञ्चालान्निशि सौप्तिके। कामं कीटः पतङ्गो वा जन्म प्राप्य भवामि वै॥२७॥
त्वरे चाहमनेनाद्य यदिदं मे चिकीर्षितम्। तस्य मे त्वरमाणस्य कुतो निद्रा कुतः सुखम्॥२८॥
verses.english: My resolution is pressing me for its accomplishment. Urged on by it, how can I enjoy sleep and happiness.

verses.sanskrit: न स जातः पुमाँल्लोके कञ्चिन्न स भविष्यति। यो मे व्यावर्त्तयेदेतां वधे तेषां कृतां मतिम्॥२९॥
verses.english: That man is not yet born in the world, nor will be, who will be able to frustrate this resolution of mine."

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              एवमुक्त्वा महाराज द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। एकान्ते योजयित्वाश्वान्प्रायादभिमुखः परान्॥३०॥
तमब्रूतां महात्मानौ भोजशारद्वतावुभौ। किमर्थं स्यन्दनो युक्तः किञ्च कार्यं चिकीर्षितम्॥३१॥
verses.english: Then Bhoja and Sharadvat's son, those great persons, addressed him saying,-'Why do you yoke the horses to your car? What do you want to do?

verses.sanskrit: एकसार्थप्रयातौ स्वस्त्वया सह नरर्षभ। समदुःखसुखौ चापि नावां शङ्कितुमर्हसि॥३२॥
verses.english: We are determined to accompany you tomorrow, O foremost of men! We sympathies with you in weal and woe. You should not mistrust us.'

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थामा तु सङ्क्रुद्धः पितुर्वधमनुस्मरन्। ताभ्यां तथ्यं तथाऽऽचख्यौ यस्यात्मचिकीर्षितम्॥३३॥
verses.english: Remembering the slaughter of his father, Ashvatthaman in anger told them truly about the work that he had resolved to accomplish.
verses.bhavadeepa: एकसार्थप्रयातौ स्वः एकसाहित्येन प्रयत्नवन्तौ स्वः अस्तेर्लेट उत्तमस्य द्विर्वचनम्॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा शतसहस्राणि योधानां निशितैः शरैः। न्यस्तशस्त्रो मम पिता धृष्टद्युम्नेन पातितः॥३४॥
verses.english: When my father having killed hundreds and thousands of warriors with sharp arrows, had thrown out his weapons, he was then killed by Dhrishtadyumna.

verses.sanskrit: तं तथैव हनिष्यामि न्यस्तधर्माणमद्यवै। पुत्रं पाञ्चालराजस्य पापं पापेन कर्मणा॥३५॥
कथं च निहतः पापः पाञ्चाल्यः पशुवन्मया। शस्त्रेण विजिताँल्लोकान्नाप्नुयादिति मे मतिः॥३६॥
verses.english: It is my determination to slay like an animal that sinful prince of the Panchalas in such a way that he may not attain to regions gained by persons killed with weapons.

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्रं सन्नद्धकवचौ सखड्गावात्तकार्मुकौ। मामास्थाय प्रतीक्षेतां रथवर्यौ परन्तपौ॥३७॥
verses.english: Put on your coats of mail soon and take your bows and swords, and wait for me here, O foremost of car-warriors.'—Having said so, Ashvatthaman got upon his car started towards the enemy. The Kripa, O king, and Kritavarman of the Satwata race, both followed him.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा रथमास्थाय प्रायादभिमुखः परान्। तमन्वगात्कृपो राजन् कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥३८॥
ते प्रयाता व्यरोचन्त परानभिमुखास्त्रयः। हूयमाना यथा यज्ञे समिद्धा हव्यवाहनाः॥३९॥
verses.english: While the three went on against the enemny, they shone like three blazing fires in sacrifice, fed with libations of clarified butter.

verses.sanskrit: ययुश्च शिबिरं तेषां सम्प्रसुप्तजनं विभो। द्वारदेशं तु सम्प्राप्य द्रौणिस्तस्थौ महारथः॥४०॥
verses.english: They proceeded, O lord, towards the encampment of the Panchalas within which everybody was asleep. Having approached the gate, Drona's son, that great car-warriors, stopped."
